known_limitations: This delivery is a lightweight demo and does not implement full authentication, role-based authorization, or permission masking.
Import/export is limited to CSV export and basic manual extension points; Excel and PDF support are not implemented.
Some advanced business workflows such as detailed approvals, custody workflows, full invoicing rules, and phased rollout tooling are represented only minimally.
The application uses a local SQLite database file and is intended for single-node use.
